data.title: Kitron completes share buyback for board remuneration, holds no treasury shares
data.description:
Kitron ASA ( (GB:0F0J) ) has shared an announcement.

Kitron ASA has completed a targeted share buyback program to support share-based remuneration for its board of directors for the period from April 2026 to April 2027, as approved by the annual general meeting. The company repurchased 9,858 shares at an average price of NOK 93.2992, which were subsequently allocated among eight board members, including chairperson Tuomo Lähdesmäki.

The buyback, executed by Norne Securities AS under EU market abuse rules, has resulted in Kitron holding no treasury shares following the transfer to board members. The transaction underlines the company’s use of equity-based incentives to align board remuneration with shareholder interests, while maintaining transparency through regulatory disclosures.

data.title: Scotiabank Sets Final Terms for GBP 2 Billion Covered Bond Issuance
data.description:
Bank Of Nova Scotia ( (TSE:BNS) ) has provided an announcement.

The Bank of Nova Scotia has agreed to issue GBP 1,250,000,000 of floating rate covered bonds due March 2030 and GBP 750,000,000 of 5.125 per cent. covered bonds due December 2032 under its CAD100,000,000,000 Global Registered Covered Bond Program. Both series, CBL76 and CBL77, are unconditionally and irrevocably guaranteed as to interest and principal by Scotiabank Covered Bond Guarantor Limited Partnership.

The final terms for these new covered bond series, dated 11 September 2026, have been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and will be available for inspection via the U.K. Financial Conduct Authority’s online portal. The admissions to trading on a regulated market, in conjunction with the existing prospectus, reinforce Scotiabank’s access to international funding and provide investors with detailed disclosures on the structure and terms of the issues.
